missions.title: Ava and Persephone
missions.desc: Year 90. Ava has the Aurora virus. Persephone is her only friend. A Government man has an offer.

lines.t: *cough* The medicine isn't working anymore...
Demonization cures all sickness. Here's an invitation - volunteers only.
Then make me a demon too. Someone has to protect Ava.

reply.t: ...I'm going anyway. I don't want to die.

steps.obj: Get Ava and Persephone through the Underclass City

missions.title: The Tenjo Family
missions.desc: Year 90. Minta, Aniri and little Yuri Tenjo hide in a run-down house. Kyle and Technica are scanning for heat.

lines.t: God, let our souls find the way to the light... Amen. Soldiers are here.
They have a heat scanner! If someone buys me time, I can crank the air system into a heat wave.
I'm the oldest. It has to be me. Remember, you two - God loves us.
God loves us.

reply.t: Then stay close. Over here, you two!
Okay - hold the door while I get it working!

escape_lines.t: Uh... what happened? KYLE! You put a chip on me?!

steps.obj: Hold the door while Yuri works

lines.t: Take that, you jerks! My YURI BOMB!
Attack mode. ...Die.
Kyle cuts Minta down.
Yuri! The heater - we have to RUN!
Let them go, Kyle - or I tell the Gov about your illegal modifications.
Caring for others is what's going to get you killed one day, Technica.

missions.title: The Draft Test
missions.desc: Year 95. Yuri Tenjo, caught trespassing at F1, takes the Government's drafting exam.

lines.t: A 100 on the drafting exam. C1. You'll be going to F2.
F2?! I got a 100! Why not F1?!
F1 is invitation only.
So you're the new girl? You look so cute!
You're not the first Tenjo here. Project Ultima is Aniri Tenjo.
God loves us! That's my big brother!
On the C3 camera: Technica, handing the gas patients keys to escape.
Later, outside C2: Gracie tells Kyle that Yuri Tenjo is here.
I was starting to think I could make friends here. Family is all I can rely on.

missions.title: Gracie and Euphoria
missions.desc: Yuri has locked herself in C1 with her brother for a month. Two girls are camping outside her door.

lines.t: We talked to her for ONE day and we're camping outside her room. I never had a sister.
Me neither. I wouldn't mind if it was Yuri.
Why are you two sitting outside C1? ...Come on, Sintrie. Gas patients.
Let's make her a cross necklace. For 'God loves us.'
You both have keys to C1, don't you? Mind if I borrow one?
We gave ours to Yuri. Ask again later.

choice.text: Tell Gracie that Kyle is up to something.

steps.obj: Search the F2 halls - something's wrong

lines.t: In Gracie's room: the half-made cross. Kyle is standing over them both.
You really shouldn't say things you don't understand.
(On the cameras - I saw it.) He's at the door. Invisible. God loves us. I'll be fine... right, big bro?

missions.title: The Day F2 Fell
missions.desc: Year 95. Yuri finishes her brother's upgrades. Kyle has other plans for him.

lines.t: Upgrades done, big bro. You just need a five-year rest...
Unseen, Kyle slips a virus into Ultima. The pod glass breaks.
Big bro?! Put me down! ...I can't control him. I have to get out!

steps.obj: F2 is falling - get Yuri out

lines.t: F2 is gone. The Government workers blew it up themselves.
There was a basement under F2. Nobody else was in it... Don't worry, big bro. We'll get him.

missions.title: God Loves Us
missions.desc: A quiet night at Yuri's HQ, before the last fight with Ultima.

lines.t: Do you believe in God, Mikiko? ...Why my family?
It wasn't God, Yuri. It was the Government. They say God gives his hardest challenges to his strongest warriors.
If we weren't demigods, we'd be called the Freedom Fighters.
What's that cool thing you do with your arms?
Cross them like handcuffs. Break out of them. 'Manifest Greatness!'
Manifest Greatness! ...I feel free. Thank you, Mikiko.
God loves us.
